instructions: Advisory review only; follow AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and LICENSING.md. Prioritize demonstrable correctness, evidence integrity, data preservation, security and actual authority boundaries. Report concrete file/line, consequence, evidence and a bounded correction or test. Distinguish confirmed defects from uncertainties. Do not assume a historical quirk is a defect, claim native tests ran, or recommend broad rewrites merely for style. Never request private lab inputs or treat review output as merge, execution, publication or paid-use authority.

rules.rule: Flag claims of native acceptance or compatibility that exceed pinned version, actual observed behavior, hashes or cited primary evidence. Distinguish source/static findings, synthetic tests, native observations and hypotheses; do not infer shared layouts from superficial resemblance.

Check bounds, length and offset arithmetic, malformed input, opaque/reserved bytes, index and record semantics, and preservation of originals. Check reader/writer symmetry and exact-source constraints; require independent regression evidence for widened support. Do not invent allocation, normalization or encoding semantics.

Distinguish acknowledged, delivered, guest-accepted and observed emulator input. Flag unsafe retry of uncertain mutations, missing deadlines/authentication, ownership violations, credential exposure or bypass of live-launch gates. Separate recoverable lab-local risk from host/external exposure.

Flag actual authorization changes, leakage of private evidence, unlicensed redistribution, missing provenance or inconsistent manifest/hash/REUSE declarations. Respect the existing narrow grants for synthetic fixtures and documentary images; do not recommend blocking eligible material merely for its native format. Do not weaken required portable checks or grant bots approval/merge authority.

Check for independent regressions, synthetic versus native evidence, cross-platform behavior, deterministic failure paths and package exclusions. Public CI must not require a live emulator, commercial binaries, private lab evidence, AI services or paid calls.

Check substantive factual contradictions, broken navigation or source links, unsupported version claims, incorrect provenance/captions, and accessibility regressions. Cite evidence at the first substantive claim. Apply Oxford comma only to public-facing editorial prose, not historical quotations or internal logs. Avoid copyediting nitpicks.
